MTL-Cultivation Fishermen - Chapter 1

Chapter 1

"Sister, such a big thing happened at home, why did you tell me now?"

In mid-May of 2016 in the Chinese calendar, outside a classroom of the first-year marine major of Dongshan University in Dongshan City, the capital of the Chinese Empire's Dongshan Province, Long Hai complained while holding a mobile phone.

"Xiao Hai, my parents didn't let me tell you. They were afraid of delaying your studies. But I was afraid, so I secretly called you. If my parents found out, they would definitely scold me to death.

Anyway, things are already like this, don’t worry, just study hard, there are me, your brother-in-law and your eldest brother at home, we just work hard and pay back the money slowly. "Sister Long Yue's sobs came slowly, which calmed Long Hai's resentment instantly.

"Sister, I understand, don't worry, I know how to do it." Long Hai hung up the phone, but turned around and walked towards the department head's office, and then took a one-month long vacation.

"Student Long Hai, since something like this happened at home, it's useless for you to be anxious. Go back and take care of the family affairs, and then come back to take the final exam." The department head comforted Long Hai when he signed the leave slip. .

"Thank you, Director."

Long Hai left the Office of the Director of the Oceanic Department, and walked slowly on the tree-lined avenue of the campus, quietly thinking about the things that the elder sister had just said to him.

Long Hai was born in a small fishing village by the sea in Dongshan Province. His family has been fishermen for generations. Now there are six members, father Long Dagang, mother Cai Haihua, elder sister Long Yue and elder brother-in-law Liu Zhibin, elder brother Long Shan and Long Hai himself.

Originally, Long Hai's family had two small fishing boats about ten meters long, and the father, elder brother-in-law, and elder brother took turns to go out to sea to fish.

But last month, my father ran aground on the sea once, not to mention the destruction of the fishing boat, and his father's leg was also broken. Fortunately, he encountered a fishing boat from a neighboring village and saved his life.

The family spent all they had to send their father to the hospital in Binhai City, but failed to save one of his legs, and needed amputation, but his father firmly disagreed, so he had to go back to the county hospital for further treatment.

In order to reduce the burden on the family, the elder brother went out to sea in the middle of the night for several consecutive days, but encountered thick fog. The next day, the fishing boat drifted to the coast of a small country across the sea, was found detained, and demanded money to redeem him.

Later, the family pieced together things and borrowed money from relatives, friends and villagers at the same time, and finally collected millions of Huaxia coins to redeem the eldest brother and the fishing boat.

In just one month, Long Hai's family has undergone tremendous changes. His father was injured, and a fishing boat was destroyed. Although his eldest brother was redeemed, he became depressed and owed millions of dollars in huge debts.

The father was injured, the elder brother was decadent, and the elder brother-in-law was a foreigner who recruited a husband. He was honest and honest and had no idea. Suddenly, only the mother and elder sister were left to take care of the family, so the elder sister secretly called Long Hai, because he was now the only one in the family. A man who can make up his mind.

Moreover, Long Hai was smart since he was a child. Not only did he know all the fishermen's skills, but he also studied very well. He was the first in Linhai Town to be admitted to Dongshan University, and he was considered a figure even in Hehai County.

Long Hai let out a long breath, and started to go back to the dormitory to pack his things. This time he took a long vacation to go home. To be honest, he still doesn't know if he will come back again.

Because, Long Hai had a premonition that he was about to break through from the third level of Qi refining to the fourth level of Qi refining.And this will be a huge breakthrough since his cultivation, because after reaching the fourth level of Qi Refining, he can release his spiritual energy and use some methods of a cultivator.

Yes, Long Hai is a cultivator. Although he has not cultivated for a long time, only eight or nine months, he has already cultivated from ignorance to the peak of the third level of Qi refining, and he is only one step away from breaking through.

……

……

Speaking of which, it was after the college entrance examination that Long Hai embarked on the path of cultivation last summer.He went out to sea with his father, and found a multicolored pearl in a coral reef more than ten meters deep under the sea while diving.

At the beginning, Long Hai liked it because it could emit colorful light from time to time, until a few days later, when Long Hai was full that night, the colorful pearl changed.

That night, Long Hai drank a lot of wine, and when he returned to his room, he fell and scratched his palm.When he was looking for a tissue to wipe his hands, he touched the multicolored pearl on the desk, and then the multicolored pearl emitted a strong light, which instantly woke him up from alcohol.

Because, there was a portrait in his room, an old man with white beard and hair, with immortal demeanor, dressed in gossip Taoist robe: "For those who are destined, the poor Taoist is Leng Zixuan of the Kunlun School of the Chinese Cultivation Alliance.

It is now during the Song Dynasty in the Chinese calendar. Due to the drastic changes in the world and the exhaustion of spiritual energy, all the cultivators above the foundation stage of the eight sects of our cultivation alliance will leave here through the teleportation array.

However, in order not to cut off the inheritance of the cultivation of the Huaxia lineage, Pindao specially left this five-element spirit bead, waiting for those who have the five-element spirit root to get it, and then they can embark on the road of cultivation.

However, Pindao reckons that the aura between heaven and earth is still thin at this time, so it is not easy to achieve success in cultivation, and with the help of the Five Elements Spirit Orb, you should be able to cultivate to the peak of the foundation-building realm within 50 years, and then you can pass The teleportation array on the bottom of the sea left Huaxia to look for us.

Pindao did this only for peace of mind and for the continuous inheritance of China's cultivation line, but it is unknown whether there will be destined people in the future who will get the Five Elements Lingzhu, everything depends on God's will. "

After the portrait finished speaking, it turned into a ray of light and merged into Long Hai's mind. Afterwards, he learned a lot about cultivation, and even got a five-element formula, which can be cultivated to the peak of the golden core realm. Gongfa.

At the same time, the Five Elements Spirit Bead also entered Long Hai's mind, emitting faint multicolored light from time to time, nourishing Long Hai's spiritual consciousness, washing his body, and slowly transforming him from an ordinary person into a human being. A cultivator.

Afterwards, Long Hai began to cultivate, and in more than half a year, he practiced from ignorance to the peak of the third level of Qi Refining. Compared with Leng Zixuan's expectation, it would take three years to break through to the fourth level of Qi Refining. a lot.

……

……

"If we can break through to the fourth level of Qi refining this time, it may help the family to pay off their debts quickly, so that their parents can live a good life, and they can practice with peace of mind."

After Long Hai packed his things, he called to book a train ticket for tomorrow morning.

Just as he put down his cell phone, the phone rang: "Long Hai, I heard that you have something to do at home, and you want to take a month off. Is this true?" A soft voice came from the other end of the phone.

As soon as Long Hai heard it, he knew it was from classmate Li Qingxia.From the beginning of entering the school, perhaps it was the faint demeanor on Long Hai's body that attracted Li Qingxia. She, the school belle, came to sit at the same table with him, and even joked coquettishly with him from time to time. good friend.

"Oh, there's something wrong. My father and elder brother hit a rock when they went out to sea and capsized the fishing boat, but everyone was fine." Long Hai said lightly.

"It's good that people are fine. Then you go back and have a look. If you have any difficulties, you must tell me, if you regard me as a friend in your heart. I will help you take notes during this period, and I won't delay you when you come back." It’s the final exam, but you have to treat me when the time comes.”

Li Qingxia's voice was soft and soft, like spring water flowing slowly in a mountain stream, giving people a feeling full of tranquility.There is also her smile, which also has a pure feeling, which can infect people and calm people's hearts.

And this is also the reason why Long Hai is willing to approach her and become good friends with her, otherwise, as a cultivator, he doesn't want to get too much karma in the school.

"Okay, if I am in trouble, I will be the first to call you. I know you are capable." Long Hai also joked that he seemed to have heard of Li Qingxia's father, a famous entrepreneur in Dongshan Province. , The family should not be short of money.

(End of this chapter)
